adjudication.rationale: The diff shows that in packages/lib/CalendarService.ts, `mainHostDestinationCalendar` is extracted from `event.destinationCalendar ?? []` at line 156. When filtering calendars at lines 160-163, if `mainHostDestinationCalendar?.externalId` exists, it filters to only calendars matching that specific externalId. For collective team events where multiple hosts have different destination calendars, this code only uses the first host's calendar URL for all CalDAV operations. The filter `c.externalId === mainHostDestinationCalendar.externalId` will return empty for secondary hosts whose calendars have different externalIds, yet the Promise.all results are still processed as if events were created. This is a real bug where secondary hosts' calendar events may not be properly created.
